`OWNERS`, `OWNERS_ALIASES`|Removed individual approvers and reviewers; added `control-plane-approvers` group alias to both OWNERS files. Alias defines 14 team members: `ardaguclu`, `atiratree`, `benluddy`, `bertinatto`, `everettraven`, `flavianmissi`, `gangwgr`, `ingvagabund`, `kaleemsiddiqu`, `p0lyn0mial`, `rh-roman`, `ricardomaraschini`, `tjungblu`, `xueqzhan`.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging.
